name: Spy’s Ring (Least Minor Ring)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 1,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This gold ring appears to be a simple albeit well-made signet ring common to merchants, diplomats and city officials.

EFFECTS

Once per day the wearer, as a move action, may invoke the power of the ring while pressing it into the wax seal of a document. When so activated, the ring’s magic alters the text of the sealed document as a secret page spell. Within the modified text is usually a cipher or other such clue to the secret word that will reveal the hidden text beneath.

Anyone wearing a spy’s ring is automatically able to perceive the true text within any document sealed by that particular ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice; Spells secret page; Cost 500 gp.
